packageRules.description: Provider constraints are ranges (`~> 5.0`): this is a library, and each root pins its exact versions in its own lock file. A version inside a range needs no PR here; one outside it is a major for the range, and every major waits for review (same pace and rules as the fleet repo and the catalogue).
Majors of anything -> REVIEW. Minors and patches auto-merge once this repo's checks pass.
